result.topic_en: Euler collects all the previously derived parts of the variation of a double-integral formula into one total expression, split into a double-integral part and single-integral boundary parts. He then remarks that what these terms mean and how they can be used is not yet clear and calls for further study.
result.transcription:
VARIATIONVM TRACTANDI. 53
29. Colligamus nunc omnes iſtas formulas in vnam ſummam, atque variatio quaeſita pluribus conſtabit membris, quarum primum formulas integrales duplicatas, reliqua vero ſimplices complectentur, hoc pacto variatio quaeſita ſequenti modo erit expreſſa:
$dt\iint dx\,dy\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right)\left\{\begin{array}{l} N-\left(\frac{dP}{dx}\right)+\left(\frac{ddQ}{dx^2}\right)-\left(\frac{d^3R}{dx^3}\right)\\ \quad-\left(\frac{dP'}{dy}\right)+\left(\frac{ddQ'}{dx\,dy}\right)-\left(\frac{d^3R'}{dx^2\,dy}\right)\\ \quad\quad+\left(\frac{ddQ''}{dy^2}\right)-\left(\frac{d^3R''}{dx\,dy^2}\right)\\ \quad\quad\quad-\left(\frac{d^3R'''}{dy^3}\right)\end{array}\right\}\text{ etc.}$
$+dt\left\{\begin{array}{l}\int\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right)P\,dy+\int Q\,dy\left(\frac{ddz}{dx\,dt}\right)-\int dy\left(\frac{dQ}{dx}\right)\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right)+\int R\,dy\left(\frac{d^3z}{dx^2\,dt}\right)\\ \int\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right)P'dx+\int Q'dy\left(\frac{ddz}{dy\,dt}\right)-\int dx\left(\frac{dQ'}{dx}\right)\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right)+\int R'dy\left(\frac{d^3z}{dx\,dy\,dt}\right)\\ \quad+\int Q''dx\left(\frac{ddz}{dy\,dt}\right)-\int dx\left(\frac{dQ''}{dy}\right)\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right)+\int R''dx\left(\frac{d^3z}{dx\,dy\,dt}\right)\\ \quad\quad+\int R'''dx\left(\frac{d^3z}{dy^2\,dt}\right)\end{array}\right.$
$\left.\begin{array}{l}-\int dy\left(\frac{dR}{dx}\right)\left(\frac{ddz}{dx\,dt}\right)+\int dy\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right)\left(\frac{ddR}{dx^2}\right)\\ -\int dy\left(\frac{dR'}{dx}\right)\left(\frac{ddz}{dx\,dt}\right)+\int dy\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right)\left(\frac{ddR'}{dx\,dy}\right)\\ -\int dx\left(\frac{dR''}{dy}\right)\left(\frac{ddz}{dy\,dt}\right)+\int dx\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right)\left(\frac{ddR''}{dx\,dy}\right)\\ -\int dx\left(\frac{dR'''}{dy}\right)\left(\frac{ddz}{dy\,dt}\right)+\int dx\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right)\left(\frac{ddR'''}{dy^2}\right)\end{array}\right\}\text{ etc.}$

Verum quid haec ſingula membra proprie ſignificent et ad quemnam vſum adhiberi queant, neutiquam adhuc perſpicere licet, unde hoc argumentum cuius prima fundamenta etiamnunc vix iacta ſunt cenſenda omnem Geometrarum attentionem atque multo accuratiorem inueſtigationem poſtulare videtur, quod negotium vix ante ſuſcipere licet, quam
G 3 caſus

items.quote: Verum quid haec ſingula membra proprie ſignificent et ad quemnam vſum adhiberi queant, neutiquam adhuc perſpicere licet
items.english: But what these individual members properly signify, and to what use they can be applied, cannot yet be perceived at all.

items.quote: unde hoc argumentum cuius prima fundamenta etiamnunc vix iacta ſunt cenſenda omnem Geometrarum attentionem atque multo accuratiorem inueſtigationem poſtulare videtur
items.english: Hence this subject, whose first foundations must be considered as still scarcely laid, seems to demand the full attention of geometers and a much more accurate investigation.
